item.title: Hendrik van den Keere's Ascendonica
item.description: Hello. For the current project I need scans of Keere’s Ascendonica font with the good resolution. I assume that this font is in Sixteenth-Century printing types of the Low Countries book, but in Moscow I couldn’t find this book. I will be grateful for the help.
